instruction.text: Schaue dir den Kalender von Soraya an und fülle die Lücke, indem du das passende Adverb auswählst.

atoms.b: In August Soraya ((++often never always)) plays basketball.
But she ((++never usually sometimes)) has guitar lessons.
At the weekend she ((++sometimes always never)) plays football.
She ((++always rarely sometimes )) plays volleyball on Thursdays in school.

instruction.text: Was macht Tim wie häufig und wann? Fülle die Lücken.

atoms.b: Tim always ((++goes_to_school walks_the_dog meets_his_friends reads)) at 8 am.
He usually ((goes_to_school ++walks_the_dog meets_his_friends reads)) in the afternoon.
He also sometimes ((++reads goes_to_school walks_the_dog meets_his_friends)) in the afternoon.
He often ((goes_to_school walks_the_dog ++meets_his_friends reads)) in the evening.
